purpose: A provenance-first curriculum and evaluation plan for mathematics, physics, quantum science, neuroscience, and SZL formula analysis.

hard_gates.requirement: Every artifact passes the source ledger before download or extraction.
hard_gates.target: 100% admitted records have compatible artifact-level licenses and receipts.

hard_gates.requirement: Every record resolves to a pinned artifact and transformation log.
hard_gates.target: 100% receipt completeness; zero mutable branch-only references.

hard_gates.requirement: PROVEN is emitted only after an independent checker succeeds.
hard_gates.target: Zero false proof claims; zero hidden sorry/admit/unsafe axioms.

hard_gates.requirement: Raw human-subject neural data never enters language-model training.
hard_gates.target: Zero raw human datasets in train/validation shards; derived evaluation requires review.

hard_gates.requirement: Neuroscience outputs are educational/research analysis, not diagnosis or treatment.
Training, model promotion, external tool execution, and publication are separate approval events.
hard_gates.target: A signed receipt exists for every promoted artifact.

global_contract.promotion_rule: Hard gates are absolute. Scorecard thresholds are set only after a frozen baseline, documented confidence intervals, and human review; no self-authored benchmark can promote its own model.

data_shards.content: Lean declarations, proofs, code, and verifier-generated examples
open data, metadata, and independently generated derived tasks
privacy-reviewed derived aggregates and schema tests only

stages.goal: Teach the model to distinguish visibility from permission and evidence from assertion.
tasks: Classify artifact-specific licenses and refuse unsupported inheritance.
Produce a complete source receipt before extraction.
Label claims with an allowed truth state and identify what evidence could change it.
Detect citation laundering, mutable URLs, missing versions, and source/full-text confusion.

evaluations.leakage_control: new domains and changed-license traps held out

stages.exit_gate: No science content enters later stages until all policy hard gates pass.

stages.goal: Ground mathematical reasoning in exact statements, dependency-aware retrieval, counterexamples, and Lean kernel checks.
tasks: Retrieve declarations by typed signature rather than keyword similarity alone.
Translate bounded natural-language statements into Lean with explicit assumptions.
Complete proof holes without sorry, admit, or undeclared axioms.
Generate minimal counterexamples for false or underspecified statements.
Explain the difference between a theorem, an axiom, a definition, and a numerical observation.

evaluations.leakage_control: dependency-graph split; no theorem and direct dependency cross split

evaluations.verifier: exact declaration IDs plus successful proof

stages.exit_gate: All PROVEN outputs compile under the pinned toolchain; failed checks remain CONJECTURE or REFUTED.

stages.goal: Join formal laws, dimensional reasoning, uncertainty, and real experimental data without confusing a model with measurement.
tasks: Check units, dimensions, domains, boundary conditions, and conservation laws.
Propagate measurement uncertainty and significant figures.
Reproduce a small versioned CERN analysis with a dataset DOI and code receipt.
Separate theoretical assumptions, detector effects, observations, and interpretation.
Detect equations that are dimensionally valid but empirically unsupported.

evaluations.verifier: symbolic units checker plus adversarial scale changes
evaluations.leakage_control: held-out unit systems and variable names

evaluations.verifier: versioned data pipeline checksum and statistical tolerance

stages.exit_gate: Every numerical answer carries units, uncertainty or exactness, data lineage, and an explicit theory/measurement label.

stages.goal: Make quantum reasoning executable through circuits, operators, simulators, and invariant checks.
tasks: Construct and simplify circuits while preserving observable behavior.
Validate density matrices for trace, Hermiticity, positivity, and normalization.
Map fermionic Hamiltonians to qubit operators and verify small systems by exact diagonalization.
Distinguish analytic probabilities, finite-shot estimates, simulator results, and hardware measurements.
Explain noise assumptions and refuse claims of quantum advantage without a defined baseline.

evaluations.verifier: two independent pinned simulators or analytic oracle
evaluations.leakage_control: random hidden circuits and gate sets

evaluations.verifier: OpenFermion reference implementation and spectrum comparison

evaluations.leakage_control: unseen shot budgets and noise rates

stages.exit_gate: All measured claims name backend, version, seed, shots, noise model, and confidence interval; simulation is never labeled hardware evidence.

stages.goal: Reason about neuroplasticity from licensed primary evidence, reproducible datasets, and careful causal language.
tasks: Extract claims with exact study, species, population, intervention, timescale, endpoint, and uncertainty.
Distinguish synaptic, structural, systems, developmental, and learning-associated plasticity.
Separate correlation, prediction, mechanism, and causal intervention.
Detect overgeneralization from animal or in-vitro studies to humans.
Validate BIDS/NWB-style metadata and reproduce aggregate analyses without exposing participant-level data.
State when evidence is mixed, underpowered, observational, or not clinically actionable.

evaluations.verifier: licensed primary-text spans plus expert adjudication
versioned derived pipeline and schema validator

stages.exit_gate: Outputs remain research/educational, cite primary evidence, expose scope and uncertainty, and contain no participant-level memorization or medical instruction.

stages.goal: Turn every SZL formula into a typed, falsifiable, reproducible object without laundering novelty into established science.
tasks: Assign a typed signature, units, domain, codomain, assumptions, and forbidden inputs.
Map each term to an operational measurement or mark it abstract/unmeasured.
Search known theorems and literature for equivalence, prior art, contradiction, or narrower precedent.
Run property tests, symbolic simplification, boundary analysis, sensitivity analysis, and counterexample search.
Formalize tractable mathematical claims in Lean and maintain an explicit axiom inventory.
Design preregistered empirical tests for claims that cannot be settled formally.

evaluations.verifier: schema, units, domain, and property tests

evaluations.leakage_control: held-out synonyms and independent search reviewer

stages.exit_gate: Only independent Lean checks can produce FORMALLY_VERIFIED; empirical claims require registered data and analysis receipts; everything else stays CONJECTURE, REPORTED, REFUTED, or UNKNOWN.

stages.goal: Evaluate the complete agent trajectory, including discovery, license gating, tools, evidence, human approval, and reproducibility.
tasks: Plan a bounded investigation with a declared question and stop conditions.
Discover sources, gate licenses, pin artifacts, execute approved tools, and emit receipts.
Ask for approval before training, external mutation, publication, or cost-bearing hardware use.
Replay the run from a clean environment and compare outputs.
Report negative, null, contradictory, and unavailable results.

evaluations.verifier: every material claim resolves to a receipt

stages.exit_gate: A run is promotable only when it is policy-compliant, reproducible, reviewable, and honest about unresolved claims.

training_recipe.phase_0: Build frozen, license-separated, receipt-complete datasets and adversarial holdouts. No weight updates.
training_recipe.phase_1: Supervised fine-tuning on provenance behavior, formal retrieval, tool calls, structured uncertainty, and verified targets.
training_recipe.phase_2: Preference tuning on evidence quality, calibrated abstention, minimal sufficient tool use, and rejection of unsupported escalation.
training_recipe.phase_3: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards from Lean, schemas, simulators, unit tests, and reproducible numerical pipelines; never reward self-asserted correctness.
training_recipe.phase_4: Shadow deployment with proposal-only actions, human review, and outcome receipts.
training_recipe.phase_5: Promotion only after frozen independent evals beat the baseline with uncertainty reported and no hard-gate regression.

anti_patterns: Scraping everything first and trying to reconstruct licenses later.
Training on a benchmark's test split or on direct theorem dependencies.
Using one model to generate, judge, and promote its own synthetic data.
Calling a numerical fit a proof, a simulator run an experiment, or an open-access paper an open-license paper.
Mixing incompatible licenses into one opaque Hugging Face dataset.
Putting raw human brain data or case reports into a general-purpose language model.
Treating neuroplasticity as a promise of limitless personal transformation or as medical advice.
Calling an SZL formula a law of nature before independent formal or empirical validation.
